It does not specify an automatic diagnostics default, first-run consent or a complete off-switch. Public plugin definitions and skills cannot establish closed-app telemetry behavior. The vendor says local agents and configured tools may send code or context to their providers; session history remains in Alan.

evidence.title: Alan overview
evidence.finding: Local and paid cloud sessions support multiple coding agents; shared sessions allow teammates to steer together. Tests run when asked or configured, not automatically on every change.

evidence.title: Alan downloads
evidence.finding: macOS 13+, Windows 10/11 x64 and Arm, Linux x86_64 AppImage and deb. Download page lists Windows 0.3.124.

evidence.title: Alan pricing
evidence.finding: Free local sessions; Individual and Team Pro start at $10 monthly per seat. Pro/Pro+/Max give $10/$50/$100 credit with cloud limited to a quarter. No automatic overages and no self-hosted license.

evidence.title: Task detail
evidence.finding: Tasks retain editable properties, brief, subtasks, attachments, activity, linked PRs and multiple sessions. Changes panel supports commit, push, create and link PRs.

evidence.title: Start a session
evidence.finding: Agent or read-only Plan mode, local desktop and connected remote targets, cloud, shared sessions, transcript and artifact navigation.

evidence.title: Coding agents and models
evidence.finding: Lists Alan Code, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor Agent, Droid, Antigravity, Grok Build, Kimi, Command Code and OpenCode. Availability is target-specific; hosted models and custom providers are separate.

evidence.title: Roles and permissions
evidence.finding: Organization and team Admin/Member roles; invitation links expire in seven days. Team or Enterprise is required for teams and membership.
